Consider the diagram shown above, where QP→=a, RS→=b, RT→=c, and RP→=d. Find QS→ in terms of a,b,c, and d.

a
QS→=b+d+c
b
QS→=a−b+c
c
QS→=c−d+b
d
QS→=a−d+b
e
QS→=a+b+c
